data.titulo: Kebebertab 5—Komi Israelik Babulon Agoi Keteechei Kogeny Inatusiekab Jerusalem
data.contenido:
Ki kitiem kayanetab Israelik eng’ ortinwek che chang’ kingomi Babulon. Kigiwirji mat ne lalei mising’ Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego nga u noto ko ki sor Jehovah ichek. Kingo kagosindan Medik ak Persik Babulon, kewirji Daniel keringetab ng’etunyik, nga u noto, ko kiriib Kamuktaindet kora inendet amu ki ker kutuswekab ng’etunyik.

Ki eng’ let, kotiach laitoriatab Persik ne keguure Kirus Israelik. Koweek anyun Israelik emennywa koga kobata kenyisiek 70 kong’eete ngenam ak kimut koba Babulon. Kingoit Jerusalem, konaam koteech hekalutab Jehovah. Nga u noto, ko ma tianit kotelel bunik boisiennywa. Ko u noto, ko ki tar kenyisiek 22 teeksetab hekalut.

Kinetigei kora agobo koweektogei Esra Jerusalem kwo kochob hekalut kogararanit. Kiga kosiirto kenyisiek 47 kong’eete ngetar keteechei hekalut. Kingosiirto anyun kenyisiek 13 kong’eete ngwo Esra Jerusalem, kwo agine Neemia kotoret koteech kogeny inatusiekab Jerusalem che kiga kobutok. Ng’alalee Kebebertab MUT kenyisiek 152 che bo istoria.

TA IBWATI isomani agobo werichu somok? Werichuto ko choronokab Daniel che kigaesio koam amitwogik che kima ko kororon. Kuree bikab Babulon werichuto Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego. Igeere werichuto eng’ pichait? Tos amu nee si ma kutung’jin kanamwoni o ko u bichu alak? Ngegeer.

Ta ibwati agobo ng’atutik che ki sirei Jehovah che kiguure Ng’atutik Taman? Ne tai eng’ ng’atutichoto ko ni: ‘Ma magat ioot cheptalelisiek alak kobatena anegei.’ Ribei ng’atutionoto bichu somogu agot nganda ma nyumnyum koyai ko u noto.

Ki kuur Nebukadnesar ne ki laitoriatab Babulon bik che chang’ che bo kamanut kobwa kogonyit kanamwoni kiga itonon. Kiga mwachi bik tugul kole: ‘Ye ogas sautitab kigondit anan iriombu, ak tuguk alak che kibutei, ko magat ogutung’ji kanamwoni bo tahabu. Chi age tugul ne ma yaei ko u noto, kewirjin sainoto mat ne lalei ne bo kwong’ut.’

Kingonai Nebukadnesar kole ma kutung’ji kanamwennyi Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego, konerech ne bo kwong’ut. Kiiyokto keguur icheget ak kogochi boroindo age kogutung’ji. Nga u noto, ko kiimaang’u Jehovah bichuto. Kilenji anyun Nebukadnesar: ‘Soruech Kamuktaindennyo ne keboisiechini, ago agot ngot ko ma soruech, ko ma kigutung’jini kanamweng’ung’ ne bo tahabu.’

Kingo kas Nebukadnesar, konerech agot mising’. Kiigoito ng’atutiet anyun kole: ‘Olal mat koeet kotesak konyil tisab!’ Ye ibata kolewen Nebukadnesar bikyik che kimen korat Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego ak kowirji mat orit. Ki o mat ne bo kwong’ut kot ko kibar liblibenetab maato bichoto kimen. Ara anyun tos kiyaak nee eng’ Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego?

Ki iit laitoriat mat orit ak koarogen ne bo kwong’ut. Koteeb kole: ‘Tos ka ma kirat ak kewirji bik somok ma?’

Kowol kiboitinkyik kole: ‘Ee, ka somok.’

Kole laitoriat: ‘Ogeero! Ageere bik ang’wan kobendoti eng’ ma. Ma ratotin ago ma laldos, ago chito ne bo ang’wan ko u malaikaiyat.’ Ki rikyi anyun mat laitoriat ak koguurso kole: ‘Sadrak! Mesak! Abed-nego! Omong’u, okwek kiboitinikab Kamuktaindet ne Toror Mising’!’

Kingomong’, kogeer chi tugul kole maam kiy. Kole laitoriat: ‘Ilosunot Kamuktaindetab Sadrak, Mesak ak Abed-nego! Kagoyook malaikaiyandennyi kosor bikyik amu ma kutung’jin ama ootei cheptalelit age tugul kobaate Kamuktaindennywa.’

Tos ma kaboorunet ne kararan nito ne bo kayanet eng’ Jehovah ne nyolu kisub?Koitosiek 20:3; Daniel 3:1-30. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOS nee ne yaaksei eng’ yu? Tinyei igoorto ne o bik. Kataach laitoriatab Babulon toek elfut agenge che bo kamanut. Boisiee kigombokab tahabu ak che bo feda ak bakulisiek che kigiibune hekalutab Jehovah eng’ Jerusalem. Kingo ta kotesetai igoorto, kotook eutab chito ak konaam kosiris eng’ inat. Ki arogenso bik ne tia!

Chito ne laitorani kasarito ko Belsasar, mochogoretab Nebukadnesar. Kiguurso anyun laitoriat keguur bikyik che ng’omen kobwa. Kingoit, kolenji: ‘Chi age tugul ne imuchi kosoman ak komwawa kit ne ibooru sirutichu, kigochin konunotoik che chang’ ak keyai koek chito ne bo somok eng’ laitornatet.’ Nga u noto, ko ma mi agot agenge eng’ bichoto ng’omen ne kiimuch kosoman anan komwa kit ne ibooru sirutichoto.

Ki kas kametab laitoriat kong’alaldos bik eng’ sautit ne o, kwo rumit ne ki mi bichoto ak kolenji laitoriat: ‘Kaigai mat iarogen, mi chito laitornateng’ung’ ne ingen agobo cheptalelisiek. Kingo ta ko laitoriat Nebukadnesar, ko kiga inde chichoto koek ne o ne bo bikyik tugul che ng’omen. Kiguure chichoto Daniel. Iyookte keguurun si konyo komwaun tuguk che ibooru sirutichu.’

Ki ye kiguur Daniel, konyo sainoto. Kingoit, koeesio konam konunotoik ak konaam komwachi Belsasar amu nee si kiisto Jehovah Nebukadnesar eng’ laitornatet. Kilenji: ‘Ki menot Nebukadnesar ne bo kwong’ut, ago ki iruokyi Jehovah kosubgei ak noto.’

Ki testai Daniel kolenji Belsasar: ‘Agot nganda ki ingen kiy age tugul ne kiyaak eng’ Nebukadnesar, ko ta ko i menot ko u inendet. Ki iibu kigombok ak bakulisiek eng’ hekalutab Jehovah ak inyon iboisiee. Kiiloosu kanamonik che kigiyaee ketik ak koik ago ma ikonyit Yaindennyo ne O. Noto amu nee si koyook Kamuktaindet eut konyo kosir ng’alechu. Ki testai kora Daniel komwa kole: ‘Chu ng’alek che kagisir, MENE, MENE, TEKEL ak UPHA-RSIN.’

‘MENE kobooru kole, kogoiit Kamuktaindet betusiekab laitornateng’ung’ ak koges. TEKEL kobooru kole kogepimanin eng’ ratilit ago kogotook kele ma i mie. PERES kobooru kole kigochin laitornateng’ung’ Medik ak Persik.’

Kingo tesetai kong’alali Daniel, ko kagonaam Medik ak Persik kong’em Babulon. Ki nam nganaset ak kobar Belsasar. Kosulda anyun kembounoto ng’alek che kiga kisir eng’ inat! Ara yaaksei nee nguno? Ta kinetigei agobo noto. Ngegeer anyun korok kit ne yaaksei eng’ Daniel.Daniel 5:1-31. Teebutik che Kineetengei

TOOGU komi ole ya Daniel! Mi keringetab ng’etunyik ago ma itoy kiy ng’etunyik! Ingen amu nee? Ng’o ne kowirjin yu mi ng’etunyik? Ngegeer.

Laitoriatab Babulon nguno ko chito ne kiguure Darius. Chamei Darius Daniel ne bo kwong’ut amu Daniel ko chi ne mie. Kolewen anyun laitoriandanato Daniel koek ne o eng’ laitornatennyi. Ki yai nito koam ng’etkong’ bik che kiboisiei tugul eng’ bounatet. Ki yai anyun ko u ni.

Ki ba konyor Darius ak kolenji: ‘Ee laitoriat, kogekosyine kele nyolu ichob ng’atutiet ne mwae kole, ma magat kosa chi kiy age tugul betusiek 30 ne ma inye. Ago chito ne kabut ng’atutionoto, ko magat kewirji keringetab ng’etunyik.’ Ma nai Darius amu nee si komach bichoto kechob ng’atutionoto. Nga u noto, ko kigeer kole ki kararan ng’olyondonoto, kosir anyun ng’atutionoto ago ki ma komugaksei kewal ng’atutionoto.

Kingo nai Daniel agobo ng’atutionoto kwo gaa ak kosa ko u ye cham ko yae. Kiingen bichoto yaach kole magoi bagach Daniel ko sa Jehovah. Kiboiboitu amu kigeer kole isuldoi kit ne ki kagopangan ne bo kobar Daniel.

Kingo kagonai Laitoriat Darius kit ne kigayai bichoto kochob ng’atutionoto, koimgei ne bo kwong’ut. Nga u noto, ko amu ki magoi wal ng’atutionoto, koyaach anyun kolenji bik kowirji Daniel keringetab ng’etunyik. Kolenji laitoriat Daniel: ‘Amoong’u ale toretin Kamuktaindet ne iboisiechini.’ Kiimgei Darius ne bo kwong’ut kot ko ma ta koru kemoi. Kingoeech, kolabat kwo kogeer keringetab ng’etunyik ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait. Koguurso kole: ‘Daniel, kiboitiotab Kamuktaindet ne sobei! Ko ta kosorun Kamuktaindeng’ung’ ne iboisiechini?’

Kowol Daniel kole: ‘Koiyook Kamuktaindet malaikayandennyin ak koger kutuswekab ng’etunyik si ma tiinyon.’

Kibaibait laitoriat ne bo kwong’ut ak kole kegonob Daniel eng’ keringet. Kile anyun kewirji keringetab ng’etunyik bik che kimachei ko bar Daniel. Kotomo agot koit keringet ng’ony, koriokyi ng’etunyik ak koam.

Ki sirji Darius bik tugul eng’ bounatenyin kole: ‘Agonu ng’atutiet ale, magat koteegis chi tugul Kamuktaindetab Daniel. Amu yae kwong’utik, ki sor Daniel si maam ng’etunyik.’Daniel 6:1-28. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KI KOBEG kenyisiek aeng’u kityo kong’eete ngonam Medik ak Persik Babulon. Keer kit ne yaaksei eng’ pichait! Mandoi Israelik eng’ Babulon. Ng’o ne kaityach ak kochamji komanda?

Chito ne kaityachi ko laitoriatab Persia ne kiguure Kirus. Keny kingotomo kesich Kirus, ko ki kalenji Jehovah maotiot Isaia kosir agobo Kirus ko u ni: ‘Tun iyae kit ne amache iyai. Tun ko ma kigerei kurgotik si kobiit inam nganaset.’ Ago eng’ iman, ko ki Kirus ne kiindochin nametab Babulon. Ki chut Medik ak Persik nganasetab Babulon kemoi. Ki ma kiger kurgotik kemounoto.

Ki kamwa kora Isaia maotiotab Jehovah kole, ta tun kogonu ng’atutiet Kirus ne bo keteech kogeny Jerusalem ak hekalunnyin. Tos kigon ng’atutionoto Kirus? Ee, ki yai ko u noto. Kilenji Israelik: ‘Oba nguno agoi Jerusalem ak oteech hekalutab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’wong’.’ Ago noto kit ne bo koyae Israelik nguno.

Nga u noto, ko ma Israelik tugul che kiimuch koweek Jerusalem amu ki banda ne loo ne bo kwong’ut. Ki kilomitaisiek 800 ago ki mi bik che yoosen ak che ki miandos che ki ma komuchi ko ba ole loo. Mi bik kora che ma ba amu ki mi tuguk alak che ki ter. Nga u noto, ko kilenji Kirus bik che ma ba: ‘Ogochi tahabu, fedaisiek ak konunotoik alak bik che bendi Jerusalem koteechei hekalut.’

Ki kigochi anyun konunotoik che chang’ Israelik che ki bendi Jerusalem. Kiigochi Kirus bichoto kora bagulisiek ak kigombok che kigaib Nebukadnesar eng’ hekalutab Jehovah kingo ng’emei Jerusalem. Ki nyor bik tuguk che chang’ che kiib ko ba Jerusalem.

Ki tar Israelik arawek ang’wan eng’ oret si koit Jerusalem, ago kiit eng’ kasarta ne ki magat. Ki kagobata kenyisiek 70 kong’eete ngeng’em Jerusalem, ago ma mi chi agot agenge ne ki meny emonoto kenyisiechoto tugul. Agot nganda kagoit Israelik emennywa nguno, ko chang’ kaimutik che ma ko nyor ko u ye ta kegeere.Isaia 44:28; 45:1-4; Esra 1:1-11. Teebutik che Kineetengei

data.titulo: Bik che Kiimang’u kole Toreti Jehovah
data.contenido:
KI CHANG’ bik che ki ba kong’eete Babulon agoi Jerusalem. Kingoit Jerusalem, ko ki ng’emat ago ki ma komi chi ne ki menyei agot agenge. Ki yaachei konaam koteech kiy age tugul kogeny.

Kit ne tai ne ki teech ko kaptisisio ole ki imuchi kogochinee Jehovah konunoik ak tiseiywek. Kingosiirto arawek tutigin, konaam Israelik koteech hekalut. Nga u noto, ko ki mi bunik che ki menyei ole ki negitee Jerusalem che ki ma komachei koteech Israelik hekalut. Ko u noto, kotiem bunichoto koomu anan koyai koarogenso Israelik si kotelel boisiet. Ki eng’ let, ko ki imuch bunichuto koyai laitoriatab Persik kogon ng’atutiet ne kiitelel teeksetab hekalut.

Kiga kosiirto kenyisiek 17 kong’eete ngomong’ Israelik eng’ Babulon. Koyookto anyun Jehovah maotikyik, choto ko Hagai ak Sekaria ko ba kolenji bik koteekso kogeny. Kiimaang’u bichoto Jehovah noto amu nee si kigas it maotik. Kiinaam anyun koteekso agot nganda ki mi ng’atutiet ne ki kale mat koyai ko u noto.

Ko u noto, konyo chito ne o eng’ laitornatetab Persia ne keguure Tatenai ak koteebe Israelik ngot ko tinyei chamjinet koteech hekalut. Komwachi Israelik Tatenai kole kingo ta ko mi Babulon, ko ki kamwa Laitoriat Kirus kole: ‘Oba Jerusalem ak oteech hekalutab Jehovah Kamuktaindeng’wong’.’

Koyookto anyun Tatenai baruet kwo Babulon koteeb ngot ko ki kamwa iman Kirus ko u noto, nganda kiga kome Kirus kasarato. Kowol laitoratab Persia ne ki laitorani kasarata kole ki kamwa iman Kirus ko u noto ak kosir kole: ‘Omete Israelik koteech hekalutab Kamuktaindennywa, ago kang’atak ale otoret ichek.’ Ki tar Israelik teeksetab hekalut eng’ kenyisiek ang’wan, ago kiboiboitu ne bo kwong’ut.

Ki siirto anyun kenyisiek che negit 48 kong’eete ngetar keteechei hekalut. Kasarata ko ki bonondos bik ago ki ma ta ko kararan hekalutab Jehovah ak nganasetab Jerusalem komugul. Ki mi Israelindet ne ki kiguure Esra Babulon ne ki nai kole ki magat kechob hekalutab Kamuktaindet. Ara tos ingen kit ne ki yai Esra?

Ki wo Esra konyor Artaserses laitoriatab Persia. Kiigochi anyun laitoriandanato mie konunotoik che chang’ koib ko ba Jerusalem. Kilenji Esra Israelik che ki mi Babulon kotoret koib konunotoichoto ko ba Jerusalem. Kiiyan bik che negit 6,000, ago kiib tahabu, fedaisiek ak tuguk alak che chang’ che bo kamanut.

Arogeni Esra amu mi bik che yaach oret che imuchi korebee tahabu, fedaisiek ak kobar ichek. Ko u noto, koguur bik tugul ko u ye igeere eng’ pichait ak kosa korib Jehovah ichek eng’ banda ne loo ne bo Jerusalem.

Ki riib iman Jehovah bichoto ago kingo kagobata arawek ang’wanu, koit Jerusalem kochamegei. Tos ma iboorwech nito kole ribei Jehovah bik che imoong’u inendet?Esra kurgetab 2 agoi 8. Teebutik che Kineetengei

NGEGEER kit ne ki yaak kenyisiek tutigin kotomo kwo Esra Jerusalem. Kasarata, ko ki mi Israelik aeng’u che ki kiguuren Mordekai ak Esta, ago ki bik che ki eechen eng’ bounatetab Persia. Esta ko kwondab laitoriat, ko Mordekai ko rubeiywotab laitoriat ago lakwetab ne tupcho ak kametab Esta. Ngegeer ole kiegundo Esta kwondab laitoriat ak ole kiegundo Mordekai rubeiywotab laitoriat.

Ki riib Mordekai Esta amu ki beg sigikab Esta ko ta koming’in. Ki tinyei Aasuerus ne ki laitoriatab Persia gotab laitornatet eng’ nganasetab Susan ago ki agenge Mordekai eng’ kiboitinikyik. Ki tinyei laitoriat kwondo ne kiguure Basiti, ago mi betut agenge ne ma kas it Basiti laitoriat, ko u noto kocheng’ laitoriat kwondo age. Tos ingen ile ki lewen ng’o? Ki lewen Esta. Ki tinyei Esta iton ne kararan. Igeere chichi menot ni kutung’jin bik? Kiguure chichito Haman. Inendet ko chi ne o eng’ bounatetab Persia. Machei Haman Mordekai kogutung’ji, Mordekai ko ni igeere eng’ pichait kotebyei ng’ony. Nga u noto, ko magoi yai ko u noto Mordekai amu ingen kole ma nyolu ko kutung’ji chi ne ya ne u ni. Ki yai nito konerech Haman ne bo kwong’ut. Tos ingen kit ne ki yai?

Ki mwachi Haman laitoriat lembechek agobo Israelik. Kile: ‘Israelik ko bik che yaach magasei it ng’atutiguk, ago magat kebar.’ Ma ingen Aasuerus kole Israelindet Esta. Ko u noto, kogas ng’alekab Haman ak komwa kole, kechob ng’atutiet ne mwae betut ne kibarei Israelik tugul.

Kingo kas Mordekai agobo ng’atutionoto, koimngei ne bo kwong’ut ak kolenji Esta: ‘Magat imwochi laitoriat agobo ng’alechu ak isom kosorwech.’ Ki ma koyani ng’atutikab emetab Persia kwo chi konyor laitoriat ko ma kitaach. Nga u noto, ki wo Esta konyor laitoriat. Ki nam laitoriat kiroktonyi ne bo tahabu ak kotokyi Esta. Ki yai ko u noto si koboor kole ma nyolu kebar Esta. Kingo mi gotab laitoriat, kotaach Esta laitoriat ak Haman koba gonnyin si kochobchi amitwogik. Kingoit gotab Esta, koteebe laitoriat Esta kolenji, kosom kiy age tugul ne machei. Kolenji Esta, mwachin kit ne machei ngot koyan kobwa laitoriat ak Haman kogeny betut ne rubei.

Kingoamisiei betut ne rubei, kolenji Esta laitoriat: ‘Kipangani kebara koboto bikyuk.’ Konerech laitoriat ak koteebe Esta kole: ‘Ng’o ne machei kotiem koyai ko u noto?’

Kowol Esta kole: ‘Chichoto ya ko bunyondoni, Haman.’

Konerech ne bo kwong’ut laitoriat ak kogon ng’atutiet kebar Haman ak kinde Mordekai koek rubeiywotab laitoriat. Kimwa Mordekai kole kesir ng’atutiet ne chamjin Israelik koborio ak bik che bwanei kobarei ichek betunoto si kosor sobonwekwak. Ki toret bik che chang’ Israelik kosorgei eng’ bunikwak amu ki chi ne o Mordekai.Bukuitab Esta. Teebutik che Kineetengei

KEER boisionik tugul che tesetai eng’ yu. Igiilegei Israelik koteechei inatusiekab Jerusalem. Kingo ng’em Laitoriat Nebukadnesar Jerusalem kenyisiek 152 che ki kosiirto ko kiiluul inatusiek ak kobeel kurgotikab Jerusalem. Kingoweek Israelik eng’ Babulon ko ma sib koteech inatusiekab Jerusalem.

Tos ibwat ole ki kastoi bik komenyei Jerusalem ko ma mi inatusiek? Ki ma ko kasei koribotin amu kiimuch kobwa bunik ak kobar ichek. Nga u noto, ko toreti nguno Neemia koteech inatusiekab Jerusalem kogeny. Tos ingen ile ki ng’o Neemia?

Neemia ko ki chitab Israel ne ki bunu nganasetab Susan ole ki menyei Mordekai ak Esta. Ki yae boisiet eng’ gotab laitoriat ago imuch ko ki choruetab Mordekai ak Esta, kwondab laitoriat. Nga u noto, ko ma mwae Bibilia kole kiboisiechi Neemia laitoriat Aauserus, boiyotab Esta. Ki boisiechi laitoriat ne ki rubei Aauserus ne ki kiguuren Artaserses.

Tos ta ibwati Artaserses laitoriat ne mie ne kiigochi Esra robisiek koib koba Jerusalem si kochob kogeny hekalutab Jehovah? Nga u noto, ko ma teech Esra inatusiekab Jerusalem. Ngegeer kit ne kiyaak si koyai Neemia boisioni.

Ki kosiirto kenyisiek 13 kong’eete kogochi Artaserses Esra robisiek kochobee hekalutab Jehovah. Neemia ko ne o ne bo bik che igochin Laitoriat Artaserses tuguk che kiee. Boisionito ko bo kamanut mising’, amu ki inendet ne igochin laitoriat divaik ak kogeer komie kole ma mi chi ne tiemei kogochi sumu laitoriat.

Tinyei Neemia tupchet ne kiguure Hanani ne kirutechi besio Neemia. Kibwa ak bik alak che ki bunu Israel. Kimwachi anyun Neemia agobo kaimutik che nyoru Israelik, ak agobo inatusiekab Jerusalem che tomo keteech. Ki yai nito Neemia koimngei ne bo kwong’ut ak kosa Jehovah.

Betut agenge kogeer laitoriat kole iimegei Neemia. Koteebe kole: ‘Amu nee si itoogu ko u yo iimegei?’ Kolenji Neemia iimegei amu inatusiekab Jerusalem che tomo keteech. Koteebe laitoriat kole: ‘Nee ne imache?’

Kowol Neemia kole: ‘Chamwo awo ateech inatusiekab Jerusalem kogeny.’ Amu mie Artaserses, ko chamji Neemia kwo ak kotoret konyor ketik che bo teekset. Kingoit Neemia Jerusalem komwachi bik tuguk che pangani koyai. Kocham anyun bik ng’alekab Neemia ak kole: ‘Onginaam teekset.’ Kingo keer bunik keteechei inatusiekab Jerusalem kolenjigei: ‘Kibendi kebare ichek ak kitelel boisiennywa.’ Ki ye kas Neemia agobo tuguk che pangani bunik, kogochi bik che yae boisiet rotonok ak ng’otwek ak kolenji: ‘Amoiywei bunikwok. Oyai luget agobo tupchosiekwok, lagokwok, kwonyikwok ak gorikwok.’

Ki nyiganitu anyun bik ne bo kwong’ut. Ki nam garikwak che bo boriet bet ak kemboi ak kotestai koteekso. Ki tar anyun teeksetab inatusiek eng’ betusiek 52 kityo. Kinyor anyun kalyet bik eng’ nganaset ak konaam Neemia ak Esra koneet bik ng’atutikab Jehovah. Koboiboitu bik ne bo kwong’ut.

Nga u noto, kotomo kogararanit kiy age tugul ko u yu kinye kotomo kimut Israelik koba koek mabusiek eng’ Babulon, amu indochin ichek laitoriatab Persia ago magat koboisiechi inendet. Nga u noto, ko ki kamwa Jehovah kole iyoogu laitoriat age ne ipchin bik kalyet. Ng’o laitoriandanoto, ago tun ibundoi ano kalyet konyo ng’ony? Kisiirto anyun kenyisiek 450 ko ma nai bik che chang’ agobo laitoriandanoto. Ki ye ibata anyun kenyisiechoto kesich lakwet ne bo kamanut. Nga u noto, ko atindoniot age nito ne ta kegeere.Neemia kurgetab 1 agoi 6. Teebutik che Kineetengei
